## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the soft bread with golden edges and place it in the smooth interior skillet.

Task description: Put the bread with golden-brown edges at the lower left of the current view into the smooth interior of the frying pan at the lower right. It is not the pale, elongated object left of center in the image.

Success criteria: Place the bread inside the skillet with its body horizontally near the designated interior position. Both that position and the bread body must be a short distance above the table rather than remaining low and close to it.

## Execution tips

- Approach the bread from above and surround flat middle areas of opposing sides with the pads, avoiding thin corners. Open only slightly wider than the grasp width to reduce contact with the black object on the left.
- Use side observations before closing to confirm the fingers straddle the bread with sufficient pad contact, avoiding image overlap while actually pressing the top or pushing it away.
- If the pot needs to be lifted or stabilized, consider grasping the exposed solid crossbar of the short loop handle above its rim, avoiding the open section and leaving room for the bread and other gripper to enter the pot.
- Near the inside of the pan, keep the lowest part of the bread and the gripper fingers high enough to clear the rim, avoiding a lateral brush that could shift the pan or make the bread slip.
- Before release, confirm the pan securely supports the bread. Keep the opening up and body stable where possible, avoiding release while suspended or tilting it so the bread rolls toward the rim.
